prompt:
Rebase PR #49 against main and resolve conflicts.

## Context
PRs #47 (system-prompt anti-fabrication) and #48 (Radarr/Sonarr Release.Quality decode fix) both merged into main while this PR was open. PR #49 ('feat: surface tool errors as structured ToolResult') touches a superset of files and now conflicts with main.

Files changed by #49:
- internal/agent/agent.go
- internal/agent/agent_test.go
- internal/agent/dispatch_notebook.go
- internal/agent/dispatch_overseerr.go
- internal/agent/dispatch_prowlarr.go
- internal/agent/dispatch_radarr.go
- internal/agent/dispatch_sonarr.go
- internal/agent/ratelimit_test.go
- internal/agent/tools.go
- internal/agent/tools_test.go

## Expected conflicts
- **internal/agent/agent.go (system prompt)**: PR #47 added an anti-fabrication block to the systemPrompt const; this PR added a tool-failure-handling block. Both should survive — they're complementary guidance addressing different failure modes. Merge them coherently in the same prompt section.
- **internal/agent/agent_test.go**: PR #47 added a test asserting the anti-fabrication text is present; this PR likely added tests around tool-result handling. Both keep.
- **internal/radarr/types.go / internal/sonarr/types.go (if touched)**: PR #48 changed Release.Quality from string to a nested Quality struct. If #49's branch still references Release.Quality as a string anywhere (e.g. in tests, dispatch code that formats output), update those usages — typical replacement is `r.Quality.Quality.Name` for the human-readable label.

## Steps
1. `git fetch origin main` and `git rebase origin/main` on the PR's branch (`agent/20260508-1715-4ab2`).
2. Resolve each conflict by reading both sides and keeping both intents.
3. After rebase, run `go build ./...` and `go test ./...`. The Release.Quality type change is the most likely place tests break — fix any usages that assumed Quality was a string.
4. Force-push the rebased branch (`git push --force-with-lease`).
5. Don't change scope. Don't drop or rewrite #49's actual feature work.

## Acceptance
- PR #49 cleanly mergeable against main (no conflicts)
- `go test ./...` passes
- Both PR #47's anti-fabrication prompt and PR #49's tool-failure-handling prompt are present in the systemPrompt
- All Release.Quality usages updated to the new struct shape
